_about: The approved catalogue the bot checks names against (the dataset's TOOL-07 licence/catalogue and TOOL-08 access-list checks have no data of their own). business_apps: online systems people get ACCESS to (Application Access team, KB-020). standard_software: installs from the Company Portal for anyone (KB-010). licensed_software: in the Company Portal once a licence is assigned (KB-009). Anything not listed is treated as non-catalogued: new software goes to the security and licensing review (KB-012), an unknown system to the Application Access team. Replace these with your organisation's real lists; matching ignores case and spacing.
